Question: All three vertices of an equilateral triangle are on the parabola \(y = x^2,\) and one of its sides has a slope of \(2.\) The \(x\)-coordinates of the three vertices have a sum of \(\dfrac{m}{n},\) where \(m\) and \(n\) are relatively prime positive integers. What is the value of \(m + n?\)
